claim_boundary: This is a narrowed external replication on one label-complete non-Nebius cohort. The Klear cohort is not treated as failure or success because the pinned file does not contain an independently evaluated resolved outcome for it. The test does not establish causality or universal Coherence Dynamics.

external_dataset.label: ground_truth_meta_json.resolved
external_dataset.schema_repair_boundary: The previous run acquired the pinned file but aborted on the first unscorable Klear row before external feature completion, prediction, metric calculation, or disposition. Missingness structure was observed; outcome values were not used to choose this repair.

modeling: Recover and seal the source final-fit models before external acquisition. Apply them without external fitting, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, threshold tuning, or calibration.
primary_metric: PR-AUC delta: frozen simple-plus-CD minus frozen simple
primary_question: Does the source-fitted Nebius 75%-horizon simple-plus-CD profile improve prediction of independently evaluated coding-task success over its paired simple profile on the label-complete non-Nebius SWE-smith external cohort?
